steps.note: Soured nonfat milk is poured through cheesecloth and the whey is thrown off.
The alkali dissolves the casein into a binder, blended and strained free of lumps.

sources.text: The casein curd, its dissolving in lime (or borax) as the binder, and the pigment and whiting added, from these; they give amounts only per batch, so none are given here.
